pokedexEntries.rb: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick ice.

pokedexEntries.ye: Loves freezing cold conditions. Relishes swimming in a frigid climate of around 14F degrees.

pokedexEntries.go: Although it can’t walk well on land, it is a graceful swimmer. It especially loves being in frigid seas.

pokedexEntries.si: In daytime, it is often found asleep on the seabed in shallow waters. Its nostrils close while it swims.

pokedexEntries.cr: The light blue fur that covers it keeps it protected against the cold. It loves iceberg-filled oceans.

pokedexEntries.rs: SEEL hunts for prey in the frigid sea underneath sheets of ice. When it needs to breathe, it punches a hole through the ice with the sharply protruding section of its head.

pokedexEntries.fr: Covered with light blue fur, its hide is thick and tough. It is active in bitter cold of minus 40 degrees Fahrenheit.

pokedexEntries.lg: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick icebergs.

pokedexEntries.em: SEEL hunt for prey in frigid, ice-covered seas. When it needs to breathe, it punches a hole through the ice with the sharply protruding section of its head.

pokedexEntries.dpp: A Pokémon that lives on icebergs. It swims in the sea using the point on its head to break up ice.

pokedexEntries.hg: Although it can’t walk well on land, it is a graceful swimmer. It especially loves being in frigid seas.

pokedexEntries.ss: In daytime, it is often found asleep on the seabed in shallow waters. Its nostrils close while it swims.

pokedexEntries.bw: A Pokémon that lives on icebergs. It swims in the sea using the point on its head to break up ice.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: The colder it gets, the better it feels. It joyfully swims around oceans so cold that they are filled with floating ice.

pokedexEntries.x: A Pokémon that lives on icebergs. It swims in the sea using the point on its head to break up ice.

pokedexEntries.y: Covered with light blue fur, its hide is thick and tough. It is active in bitter cold of -40 degrees Fahrenheit.

pokedexEntries.oras: Seel hunts for prey in the frigid sea underneath sheets of ice. When it needs to breathe, it punches a hole through the ice with the sharply protruding section of its head.

pokedexEntries.us: It has always been supposed that Seel live only in cold seas. Their having shown up in Alola is a mystery.

pokedexEntries.um: Thanks to its thick fat, cold seas don’t bother it at all, but it gets tired pretty easily in warm waters.

pokedexEntries.lgpe: Loves freezing-cold conditions. Relishes swimming in a frigid climate of around 14 degrees Fahrenheit.

pokedexEntries.bdsp: This Pokémon lives on icebergs. It uses the sharp point on its head to break up ice as it swims in the sea.
